# humanKIND Classroom

> humanKIND Classroom is a social skills program for early childhood teachers (Pre-K through Grade 2). Created by Cara Zelas, a Montessori-trained educator and children's book author, it uses story-based routines to help young children practice kindness, friendship, and big feelings every day.

## Pages

- [Home](https://humankindclassroom.com/): Overview of the humanKIND Classroom program and philosophy
- [Kit](https://humankindclassroom.com/kit.html): The humanKIND Classroom Kit — books, puppets, lesson plans, and visual tools for early childhood classrooms ($397)
- [Preview](https://humankindclassroom.com/preview.html): A look inside the curriculum — stories, lessons, and practical teaching tools
- [Schools](https://humankindclassroom.com/schools.html): School partnership programs for preschools and elementary schools
- [About](https://humankindclassroom.com/about.html): About Cara Zelas — educator, author, and creator of humanKIND Classroom

## About the Creator

Cara Zelas is a Montessori-trained early childhood educator, children's book author, and the founder of humanKIND Classroom. She is also the creator of Big World of Little Dude, a children's book series for ages 3-8.
